desc: The Winchester Supreme quality and performance at the range and in the field ensures you have a dependable optic to trust on your favorite rifle, for your next great adventure on paper or game. Premium lenses transmit the maximum amount of light to your eye through Winchester WINcoat multicoating. This coating not only reduces harsh glare but carrier accurate color while providing a durable scratch resistant coating to exterior lens surfaces. Winchester Supreme riflescopes utilize Second Focal Place (SFP) reticles. This means that the reticle stays the same size throughout the scope's magnification range, while only the image changes size. This allows for the most precise shot placement at any distance, and the reticle will always have the same appearance.
